content: Hi how can i assist you today
My heart rate spikes exactly when I think about a stressful topic, even when I’m sitting still.
Heart rate can respond to thoughts as well as movement. Do your logs show spikes alongside notifications, caffeine, or sudden posture changes?
Some spikes coincide with email alerts and coffee.
Those are common contributors. A quiet 10-minute window without notifications or caffeine gives a baseline to compare against a typical afternoon.
I’ll try a quiet window and check the graph.
A two-column note—context vs. bpm—can make the differences clearer later.
